create_stats_instance: create a Stats object with a count and keyword arguments for custom metrics
sum_stats_list: sum a list of Stats objects aggregating all metrics and counts together
average_stats: average the metrics in a Stats object by dividing each metric by its count
average_list_of_stats: compute the weighted average of a list of Stats objects using average_list
serialize_stats_to_dict: convert a Stats object to a dictionary with count and metrics keys for serialization
